description: What is actually configured for this app: the setup checklist, every Fictura feature toggle and whether it is on, and which third-party integrations (Stripe, RevenueCat, Slack, Sentry, App Store Connect, …) are connected. Use it to check whether a feature is enabled before writing code that depends on it — a disabled tool is a server-side kill switch the SDK obeys.
name: get_setup_status
title: Get integration and feature status
